description: Open-source multichannel commerce platform: one product catalog and stock ledger published to Shopify and eBay, with a REST API, TypeScript, Python and PHP SDKs, an MCP server, webhooks and n8n nodes for scripts and AI agents.
rules: Call the REST API at https://api.crossmart.io/api/v1 with an API key in the x-api-key header; every resource is scoped to a workspace.
Prefer the official SDKs (@crossmart/sdk, crossmart for Python, crossmart/crossmart-php) over hand-written HTTP calls.
Send prices as decimal strings in the workspace currency, not as numbers.
Stores are connected in the Crossmart dashboard because the marketplace asks the seller to approve access; the API publishes to stores that are already connected.
Verify webhook signatures before trusting a webhook payload.
